description.value: Moka House has been a community focal point in Victoria's Cook Street Village since 1996, built around specialty espresso and small-batch heirloom Sacred Acre coffee roasted under the Navigator Espresso blend. The café is known for what it calls the best patio in the city — a natural place to linger and people-watch after a ride through the neighbourhood. A second location operates in Cadboro Bay Village, making it a recognisable stop across two distinct cycling destinations in Victoria.
